description: This is a Java class defining a custom runtime exception 'RollbackTransactionNotApprovedException' used within the Fineract project to indicate that a transaction rollback was not approved, typically due to maker-checker rules, and encapsulates a command processing result.

classes.name: RollbackTransactionNotApprovedException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a transaction rollback was not approved, extending RuntimeException and containing a CommandProcessingResult instance.

methods.name: RollbackTransactionNotApprovedException
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with a command ID and entity ID, building the CommandProcessingResult with rollback indication.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Returns the CommandProcessingResult associated with this exception.
